Omurice: chicken and veggies with fried rice, topped with an omelette and ketchup

Time: ~30min

-2 eggs

-2 chicken breasts

-1 green pepper

-half a carrot

-half cup rice (I use Japanese rice, basmati or other types don’t usually go as well I have found)

-ginger

-garlic

-soy sauce

-ketchup

wash rice and cook on stove so it cooks as you do everything else.

Cut chicken into bite sized parts and put it with ginger, garlic, and soy sauce.

Cut the green pepper into smallish bits. shave the carrot with a veggie peeler into shavings, thats how I like the texture anyway.

when the rice is nearly done, cook the chicken a bit, then add carrot shavings. add green pepper. add rice and stir. put aside on a plate and cover.

cook a flat 2 egg omelette and put atop the other food. add ketchup to taste. or you could cook the omelette at the same time as the other ingredients and everything will be done at the same time. if you cover the food, I usually microwave it for 20sec just to make it taste like it was done at the same time as the omelette.

its easy to prepare a lot of the ingredients at once so you can make it many days in a row. prepare all the ingredients and put them in bags, just take as much of each as you’d like, cook them, and make an omelette. I do this sometimes if I want a refreshing but warm meal that doesn’t take too long.
My version of Omurice: Japanese Chicken and veggies with fried rice, topped with an omelette and ketchup. warm but very refreshing I find, even in the summer.
